tools.name: ic_search
tools.description:
Full-text search of Indiana Code sections. Returns section ids, headings and short snippets (one hit per section); fetch the text
        with ic_get_section. `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD) picks the year's snapshot; `title` limits to one title number such as '31' or '7.1'.

tools.name: ic_resolve_citation
tools.description:
Find Indiana Code citations in free text ('IC 31-16-15-25', 'I.C. § 7.1-1-1-1', 'Ind. Code § 35-42-1-1 (2024)') and return canonical
        section ids, headings, and nearby sections when an id does not exist.

tools.name: ic_get_section
tools.description:
Text of one section, e.g. section_id '31-16-15-25', as of a date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today). Returns the version in force with
        effective dates, amending acts, acts that take effect later (pending_acts), a confidence level and flags. Check `flags` and
        `confidence` before relying on a

tools.name: ic_get_versions
tools.description: All distinct versions of a section across 2017 to 2026 with effective dates, the years each appeared in, and the act clauses that touch it.

tools.name: ic_browse
tools.description: Outline of the Code. With no node_id, list titles; with '31' list articles; with '31-16' chapters; with '31-16-15' sections (latest snapshot).

tools.name: ic_get_act
tools.description: The Code sections an act amended, added or repealed, with effective dates. act_id like 'P.L.98-2026' (loaded for 2017 and 2019 to 2026). Long acts are paged with limit and offset.

tools.name: ic_list_companion
tools.description: List Constitution, Non-code, full Acts, and archive-title PDFs loaded from the IGA downloads page. kind is constitution, noncode, acts, or archive_title.

tools.name: ic_search_companion
tools.description: Full-text search of companion PDFs (Constitution, Non-code statutes, full Acts text, archive titles). Use ic_get_companion for a page.

tools.name: ic_get_companion
tools.description: One page of a companion document (doc_id like 'constitution-2026' or 'acts-2026'). Pages are 1-based.

tools.name: case_search
tools.description: Search Indiana Supreme Court, Court of Appeals, and Tax Court clusters from a CourtListener extract. court is ind, indctapp, or indtc. form is memorandum or opinion when decision forms are indexed (text classification, not official status). disposition is affirmed, reversed, remanded, vacated, dismi

tools.name: case_get
tools.description: One Indiana opinion cluster by CourtListener cluster id. Includes opinion text only when the extract has a body. Includes author when that index is loaded: the slip byline, not the trial judge and not a holding. version_signal is a caution (yellow / red / year banner), never a green certified mark.

tools.name: ic_cases_citing
tools.description: Opinions whose text mentions this Code section (IC / Ind. Code citations). section_id like '35-42-1-1'. This is a text-mention index, not a citator: it does not say the case construed, applied, or followed the statute, and it is not a good-law signal. court is ind, indctapp, or indtc.

tools.name: cases_construing
tools.description: Opinions with a citation-sentence signal for this Code section. relation is construes or applies. section_id like '35-42-1-1'. Status is rule_unreviewed: not a holding, not a citator, not good law. court is ind, indctapp, or indtc.

tools.name: cases_citing_case
tools.description: Opinions whose text cites this case. query is a CourtListener cluster id, a reporter cite such as '848 N.E.2d 341', or an Indiana case number such as '22A-CT-925'. Text-mention index only: not a citator, not treatment, not good law. court is ind, indctapp, or indtc.

tools.name: cases_cited_in
tools.description: Cases this opinion's text cites, resolved against Harvard reporter identifiers and Rule 22 case numbers. query is a cluster id, reporter cite, or case number. Unresolved federal and sister-state reporter mentions are listed separately. Text-mention index only: not a citator, not treatment, not good

tools.name: cases_citing_court
tools.description: Indiana opinions whose text has a (court year) parenthetical. court is an Indigo-style abbreviation such as '7th Cir.', 'N.D. Ind.', 'S.D. Ind.', or 'Ill.'. year is optional (2021). citing_court filters the citing Indiana court (ind, indctapp, indtc). Text-mention index only: not a citator, not trea

tools.name: iac_search
tools.description: Full-text search of the electronic Indiana Administrative Code. year is an edition year such as 2006; omit it to use the edition iar.iga.in.gov labels Current. Returns section ids, headings and snippets; fetch text with iac_get_section. title is an IAC title number such as '10' or '312'. Unofficial;

tools.name: iac_resolve_citation
tools.description: Find IAC citations in free text ('10 IAC 1.5-1-1') and return canonical section ids. year selects a loaded edition; omit it for Current. This is not an Indiana Code (IC) resolver.

tools.name: iac_get_section
tools.description: Text of one IAC section, e.g. section_id '10-1.5-1-1' or '10 IAC 1.5-1-1'. year selects a loaded edition; omit it for the edition iar.iga.in.gov labels Current. Unofficial; not legal advice.

tools.name: iac_browse
tools.description: Outline of the IAC. With no node_id, list titles; with '10' list articles; with '10-1.5' rules; with '10-1.5-1' sections. year selects a loaded edition; omit it for Current.

tools.name: local_rules_browse
tools.description: Posted current local-rule compilations for Indiana counties. No county lists all 92 with posted/missing status. county is a slug such as 'lake-county' or a name such as 'Lake'. Missing counties name Trial Rule 81(G); this tool does not contact clerks. Unofficial; not legal advice.

tools.name: local_rules_search
tools.description: Full-text search of posted current county local-rule PDFs. county optionally narrows to one county name or slug. Proposed rules are not indexed. Fetch a page with ic_get_companion using the returned doc_id. Unofficial; not legal advice.

tools.name: judicial_officers_browse
tools.description: Pre-election roster of Indiana judicial officers from the official Directory of Courts and Clerks (trial, 2026-10-21) and appellate bios (2026-10-27). county is a name such as 'Adams'. court is 'Circuit Court' or 'Indiana Supreme Court'. role is judge, magistrate, justice, or chief_justice. Not a po

tools.name: judicial_officers_search
tools.description: Name search of the pre-election judicial officer roster. query is a surname or part of a name. Not a post-canvass list. Not salaries. Unofficial; not legal advice.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: judicial_officers_browse, judicial_officers_search · Private data: ic_get_companion, local_rules_browse · Public sink: judicial_officers_browse, judicial_officers_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: judicial_officers_browse, judicial_officers_search · Private data: ic_get_companion, local_rules_browse · Public sink: judicial_officers_browse, judicial_officers_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "case_get" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "One Indiana opinion cluster by CourtListener cluster id. Includes opinion text only when the extract has a body. Includes author when that index is loaded: the slip byline, not the trial judge and not a holding." → after: "One Indiana opinion cluster by CourtListener cluster id. Includes opinion text only when the extract has a body. Includes author when that index is loaded: the slip byline, not the trial judge and not a holding. version_signal is a caution (yellow / red / year banner), never a green certified mark."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
